title: Analysis and Implementation of Abstraction Layer for Different SDK’s - Part 2
description: Node agent is a small component that is deployed along with the block chain node software. This software will be released as part of the Blockchain node image. This is responsible for starting listeners for block and transaction events. It also monitors node logs and updates to smart contracts. It publishes updates on topics the clients can listen on. Webserver will listen for these events and does the necessary updates to MongoDB and updates web client.
